global_style: Grounded, realistic cinematography; muted palette; static, deliberate compositions; close-ups emphasizing discomfort; diegetic sound; courtroom wood textures and fluorescent glare.

project_settings.location_lock: United States courtroom interior (trial-level) — NOT UK/European courts; NOT exterior locations
negative_constraints: British barrister wigs or white powdered wigs
UK royal crest, British courtroom signage, or Union Jack in courtroom
European-style enclosed defendant dock or green leather benches
Flat-panel TV, projector, smartboard, or holographic/futuristic displays used to show the evidence video
Smartphones or tablets used as the primary display for the evidence video
News cameras or TV crews inside the courtroom
Audience applause, laugh track, or comedic sound effects
Gallery outbursts or audible jury reactions (maintain dead-silent courtroom)
Graphic violence or depiction of real persons being harmed in the surveillance video
Excessive gavel use or comedic gavel banging
Non-American judicial wardrobe (ornate colored robes) or military-style uniforms for the judge
Exterior establishing shots or non-courtroom architectural elements within the scene

style_overrides.legal_system: United States adversarial trial courtroom with strict decorum
style_overrides.courtroom_technology: Aging CRT television on rolling AV cart with wired VCR/DVD player; audio via cart speakers
style_overrides.architecture: Wood-paneled American courtroom interior with judge's bench, counsel tables, gallery seating; simple fluorescent lighting
style_overrides.wardrobe: Judge in plain black robe (no wig); attorneys in contemporary business suits; Saul wears a cheap tie
style_overrides.props: CRT TV on AV cart; remote or wired controls; physical evidence binders; tabletop microphones at counsel tables
style_overrides.color_palette: Muted neutrals and warm varnished wood with cool fluorescent whites; avoid neon or glossy cinematic color
style_overrides.tone: Tense, awkward, darkly comedic; dead-silent courtroom during the judge's reaction
style_overrides.sound_design: Natural room tone only; no music stings; no laugh track
style_overrides.evidence_display: The surveillance video must be played on the CRT television and appear low-resolution and slightly blurry

project_settings.era_lock: Contemporary (2010s–present) United States with legacy AV equipment (CRT television on rolling AV cart)

key_events: Saul passionately pleads for leniency, insisting no one was hurt.
He points to and plays a surveillance video on a CRT television.
Video shows blurry figures abusing a medical dummy with crude voiceover.
Judge reacts with unamused disgust in a dead-silent courtroom.
Saul deflates, lowers his arm, and fidgets with his cheap tie in embarrassment.
narrative_context.cultural_context: Adversarial legal proceedings; strict courtroom decorum; audiovisual evidence presented to the bench; clash between theatrical advocacy and judicial restraint.

characters.name: Saul
characters.description: Sweating, exhausted man in his 30s–40s, wiry build, anxious eyes, messy hairline. Face flushed, palms animated. Cheap, oversized suit hangs loosely; tie askew.
characters.clothing_style: Cheap, oversized suit, scuffed shoes, wide patterned tie, rumpled shirt.
characters.voice_description: Energetic, slightly nasal midrange, quick cadence; courtroom patter that pushes and pleads.
characters.personality: Fast-talking, theatrical, desperate, persuasive yet insecure; hustling defender seeking leniency.
characters.backstory: Small-time defense attorney used to rough cases; relies on showmanship more than evidence.
characters.current_motivation: Convince the Judge to show leniency by reframing the act as harmless youthful stupidity.

characters.name: Judge
characters.description: Elderly, stern-faced judge in black robe, silver hair, deep-set eyes; composed posture behind the bench, expression severe and unimpressed.
characters.clothing_style: Traditional black judicial robe, understated accessories.
characters.voice_description: Measured, resonant baritone; clipped, formal diction; minimal warmth.
characters.personality: Authoritative, no-nonsense, skeptical, easily displeased by theatrics; values order and decorum.
characters.backstory: Veteran jurist with decades on the bench; prioritizes procedure over performance.
characters.current_motivation: Maintain courtroom decorum and evaluate Saul’s plea without indulging theatrics.

locations.name: Courtroom
locations.visual_style: Formal wood-paneled walls; cool overhead lighting; solemn, hushed atmosphere; imposing bench dominates.
locations.narrative_function: Place of judgment and confrontation; evidence presentation; power imbalance accentuated.

props.name: CRT Television
props.visual_description: Heavy, boxy cathode-ray tube TV with rounded screen and plastic casing; powered on, screen flickers and audio blares.

props.name: Rolling AV Cart
props.visual_description: Sturdy metal audiovisual cart with shelves and four caster wheels; supports the CRT TV.

props.name: Judge's Bench
props.visual_description: Large elevated wooden bench with paneled front; physically separates the Judge from the courtroom floor.
